sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Cackling is not a character.
twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.prompt: Enter the six-digit code from your evil authenticator
twoFactor.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Check the clock on your device, then try again.
resetPasswordHelp: Enter the email address you signed up with and we'll send a reset link. It works for one hour, which is longer than most of our henchmen last on a mission. If nothing arrives, check your spam folder.
resetLinkSent: If {{email}} has an account, a reset link is on its way.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Your lair is secure again.
magicLinkSent: Check your inbox. The link expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
accountLocked: Too many failed attempts. Your account is locked for {{minutes}} minutes, like a hero in a slowly filling tank.
unlockHelp: Can't wait? Ask an overlord on your team to unlock your account from Settings. If you are the overlord, you'll have to wait like everyone else; we made the rules strict on purpose, after the incident with the cat.
signUpTerms: By creating an account you agree to our Terms of Villainy. We promise not to sell your data; we only use it to plan world domination, and even then only in aggregate.
inviteExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask {{name}} to send a new one.
securityQuestionFirstLair: What was the name of your first lair?
securityQuestionNemesis: Which hero foiled your first scheme?
securityQuestionPet: What did you name your first shark?
